name: Cultural Exchange — two players exchange control of the chosen creatures
notes: Sweep group 6 (2026-10-07). "Choose any number of creatures target player controls." was read as a modal header ("choose any number") and the whole one-line spell was dropped. A "Choose" sentence that names permanents or players is no longer a mode header, and the exchange is one control effect over any number of picks (params.swapAmongTargets): each pick goes to the other of the two players who controlled the picks as the spell was cast. Two creatures a side are picked here; Runeclaw Bear, not picked, stays.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Goblin Piker
scryfallData.flavor_text: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

scryfallData.name: Runeclaw Bear
scryfallData.flavor_text: The magic of the elves leaves its mark on the forest. The magic of the forest leaves its mark on the animals who live there. The animals of the forest leave their mark on all who trespass.

scryfallData.name: Cultural Exchange
scryfallData.oracle_text: Choose any number of creatures target player controls. Choose the same number of creatures another target player controls. Those players exchange control of those creatures. (This effect lasts indefinitely.)
